# FountainPen.it

> A comprehensive Italian wiki dedicated to fountain pen history, mechanics, and enthusiast community.

FountainPen.it is a volunteer-run MediaWiki project serving as a knowledge base for fountain pen enthusiasts. It covers everything from the history of pen innovations (Poenaru, Waterman) to technical guides on materials, filling systems, and pen mechanics, with an active community forum and portal structure.

## Key Topics

- Fountain Pen History
- Stilografica (Italian fountain pens)
- Lewis Edson Waterman
- Petrache Poenaru
- Pen Mechanics & Function
- Filling Systems (Caricamento)
- Materials & Construction
- Vintage Pens
- Historical Manufacturers
- Brand Directory
- Creative Commons & GFDL Licensing
- MediaWiki Platform
- Fountain Pen Community
- Technical Restoration
- Writing Instruments

## Core Content & Introduction

- [Main Page - FountainPen](https://www.fountainpen.it/Pagina_principale): FountainPen.it main hub covering fountain pen history, mechanics, and enthusiast community.
- [Stilografica - FountainPen](https://www.fountainpen.it/Stilografica): Comprehensive guide to fountain pens (stilografica) covering history from Poenaru to Waterman.
- [FountainPen:Informations - FountainPen](https://www.fountainpen.it/FountainPen:Informazioni): About page describing FountainPen as a voluntary wiki project on fountain pens.
- [Template:Pagina principale/Introduzione - FountainPen](https://www.fountainpen.it/Template:Pagina_principale/Introduzione): Homepage template introducing FountainPen.it community and MediaWiki platform.
- [Template:Pagina principale/Breve storia - FountainPen](https://www.fountainpen.it/Template:Pagina_principale/Breve_storia): Brief history of fountain pens from Egypt through Poenaru and Waterman innovations.

## History & Manufacturers

- [Portale Storia - FountainPen](https://www.fountainpen.it/Portale_Storia): History portal indexing vintage pen manufacturers from late 1800s-early 1900s.
- [Waterman - FountainPen](https://www.fountainpen.it/Waterman): Waterman brand history and Lewis Edson Waterman's fountain pen manufacturing legacy.
- [Categoria:Marche - FountainPen](https://www.fountainpen.it/Categoria:Marche): Brand directory cataloging fountain pen manufacturers from Italy, Europe, and America.

## Technical Guides & Mechanics

- [Funzionamento di una penna stilografica - FountainPen](https://www.fountainpen.it/Funzionamento): Technical guide explaining fountain pen mechanics, ink flow, and nib functionality.
- [Portale Tecnica - FountainPen](https://www.fountainpen.it/Portala_Tecnica): Technical portal covering pen anatomy, mechanisms, materials, and repair restoration.
- [Caricamento - FountainPen](https://www.fountainpen.it/Caricamento): Technical reference on fountain pen filling systems and ink-loading mechanisms.
- [Materiali - FountainPen](https://www.fountainpen.it/Materiali): Technical guide to fountain pen materials including ebanite, celluloid, and construction.
- [Template:Pagina principale/Come usare - FountainPen](https://www.fountainpen.it/Template:Pagina_principale/Come_usare): How-to guide for using fountain pens covering technique, grip, and beginner tutorials.

## Community & Support

- [FountainPen.it Forum - Indice](https://forum.fountainpen.it): Community forum for fountain pen enthusiasts with pen show events and user discussions.
- [Help:FAQ - FountainPen](https://www.fountainpen.it/Aiuto:FAQ): Frequently asked questions providing help and support for FountainPen.it users.
- [FountainPen:Donations - FountainPen](https://www.fountainpen.it/FountainPen:Donazioni): Donation page supporting FountainPen.it volunteer project via PayPal.

## Documentation & Licensing

- [Help:How to cite - FountainPen](https://www.fountainpen.it/Aiuto:Come_citare): Citation guide covering Creative Commons and GFDL licensing requirements.
- [FountainPen:Copyright - FountainPen](https://www.fountainpen.it/FountainPen:Copyright): Copyright policy detailing GFDL and Creative Commons CC-BY-SA licensing.
- [Template:PaginaPrincipale/Sommario - FountainPen](https://www.fountainpen.it/Template:PaginaPrincipale/Sommario): Navigation summary template organizing FountainPen.it portal structure and content.
